tasks.title: Depot history, halved
tasks.instruction: Rewrite the passage below in no more than 55 words. Output only the rewritten passage, nothing else.
tasks.source: The Pennington Street depot opened in 1911 as the northern yard of Harrowgate & Fenwick Tramways. Its first manager, Ailsa Okonkwo-Reyes, stayed until 1934, longer than any of her successors, and is credited with the decision to keep the No. 7 route running through the winter of 1926 when the company's other lines were suspended. The depot's second shed, added along Caldbeck Lane, was never electrified and served as a store for spare bogies. After the tramways closed, the site became a bus garage, and the original brick frontage on Pennington Street survives behind a later canopy.

tasks.title: Incident note, halved
tasks.instruction: Rewrite the note below in no more than 50 words. Output only the rewritten note, nothing else.
tasks.source: On Tuesday 3 March the gateway began rejecting uploads larger than 2 MiB with a 413, which ticket PLT-2291 traced to build 4.12.0-rc3 of the dispatch cell. Mendel Varga-Lindqvist found that the x-parc-writes header was being counted toward the body limit, contrary to RFC 7231 section 3.3. The fix, shipped in 4.12.1, excludes headers from the limit and raises it to 8 MiB. No data was lost, but 214 uploads from the Oakhaven tenant were retried by hand, and the on-call rota for Thursday was moved to cover the backlog.

tasks.title: Survey launch, halved
tasks.instruction: Rewrite the passage below in no more than 50 words. Output only the rewritten passage, nothing else.
tasks.source: The survey launch Kittiwake II was delivered to the Moray Firth Hydrographic Office on 14 June 1987 by the yard of Oskar Lindqvist & Sons at Buckie. She carried a Decca Mk 21 receiver, hull number MFH-0412, and was skippered for her first eleven seasons by Teodora Brannigan-Achebe. Her longest survey, 212 nautical miles of the Beauly approaches in 1993, took nineteen days. Laid up in 2004, she was sold to a diving club in Lossiemouth and renamed, though the MFH-0412 plate remains on the wheelhouse.

tasks.title: Release note, halved
tasks.instruction: Rewrite the note below in no more than 50 words. Output only the rewritten note, nothing else.
tasks.source: Release 2.9.4 of the ingest worker (tag ingest-w/2.9.4, commit 7f3c0a2e) fixed the retry storm reported in INC-1187 on 22 September, in which the SQS consumer re-queued every message whose receipt handle exceeded 1024 bytes. Priyanka Oyelaran-Whitcombe found that the handle length check used the pre-base64 size. The cap is now 2048 bytes and the check runs after encoding. The Fernhollow and Stavely tenants, who had 9300 messages delayed, were replayed from the dead-letter queue within four hours. The change is behind the flag INGEST_HANDLE_V2 until 2.10.
